page_note: Heavily damaged page (94.7%) consisting almost entirely of editorial material: NT-figure polemic (Satan entering Judas, Judas Iscariot delivering the Savior to the Jews, Paul as persecutor of the Church) followed by citation and interpretation of the Gospel parable of the two trees ('the Savior spoke ... concerning the beautiful tree and the bitter tree'). The page operates in citation/exegetical/polemical voice throughout — no impersonal cosmological substrate is recoverable. Even the closing 'Pillar' fragment is too lacunose to extract. The negative editorial fatigue score is misleading because the second half is largely lacuna; both halves are editorial in character.
